station_name: San Joaquin River below Friant, Calif.
township_range_section: SW¼ sec.7, T.11 S., R.21 E.
notes: Annual peak stages and discharges. Rows: left half water years 1908-1917 and 1920-1937 = 28 (1918, 1919 not printed); right half 1938-1965 = 28; 56 rows in all. Discharge: 56 values. Gage height: 50 values (dashes for 1908-1913). 56 + 50 = 106. Water year 1952 has two dates printed (Apr. 14, 1952, May 13, 1952) for one gage height and one discharge, counted once. Dates = first and last printed peak dates (first is 'Apr. 30, May 1, 1908'). Location text also: on left bank 0.5 mile west of Friant, 1.5 miles downstream from Cottonwood Creek, 2 miles downstream from Friant Dam, at mile 268.1. Published as 'near Pollasky' prior to December 1908 and as 'near Friant' January 1909 to September 1938; earlier sites 4.5 and 2.5 miles upstream. No county printed.
